description.narrative: This project seeks to create a self-sustaining system for administering a safe and reliable national road network. It seeks to strengthen the core planning activities of the MOWT, as well as the design, maintenance and administration of roads under the auspices of the NWA. It will support the initiative of contracting out road maintenance, instead of executing the works by force account.
